catalog responsive_household 1.
provenance text "Book I 94e2c582: B01-C01-S03, B01-C04-S02, B01-C06-S01, B01-C08-S02; PR 1 review" "2026-11-26".
layers (story).
stages (live).
namespace household produce (story).
type task {call_one call_two dinner}.
type trip {appointment errand}.
type status {waiting ready queued committed spoken closed disputed}.
pred promise(task,trip) : household.
pred returned(trip) : household.
pred state(task,status) : household.
pred reconcile(task) : household.
pred question(task) : household.
pred retry(task) : household.
pred attention : household.
pred authorize : household.
pred receipt(task) : household.
stage live {
  %% B01-C01-S03 "It belonged to a future event: his return."
  %% The host matches an observed return to this promise's outing.
  due [story] : $promise(T,J) * $returned(J) * state(T,waiting) -o state(T,ready).
  %% B01-C06-S01 "At five forty-five, she mentioned it."
  %% Nina queues one ready reminder per optional speaking opportunity.
  select [story] : state(T,ready) * attention -o state(T,queued).
  %% Review 3 "Distinguish queued, committed and actually spoken notifications."
  %% Nina commits only after the host closes this epoch's evidence batch.
  commit [story] : state(T,queued) * authorize -o state(T,committed).
  %% The simulated speaker returns a delivery receipt. Selection alone makes no sound.
  deliver [story] : state(T,committed) * receipt(T) -o state(T,spoken).
  %% B01-C08-S02 "an activity he had already completed."
  %% A supported resident report closes the task in its current state.
  close [story] : state(T,S) * reconcile(T) -o state(T,closed).
  %% B01-C04-S02 "What had changed was the explanation connecting them."
  %% The unresolved disagreement blocks further optional speech on this promise.
  reopen [story] : state(T,S) * question(T) -o state(T,disputed).
  %% A resident who heard a reminder can explicitly ask Nina to try again.
  postpone [story] : state(T,spoken) * retry(T) -o state(T,ready).
}
